evidence.identity_reference_scope: The local canonical wand PNG is a historical 2D illustration inspected by the parent reviewer. Use only for identity features and wand design, never as 3D style/material/lighting golden authority.

identity_master_documented.sha_evidence: read from canonical lock; not reverified against downloaded bytes

immutable.identity: original fairy-firefly preschool teacher; warm, magical, encouraging, curious and safe; no humanization
immutable.head_proportions: large rounded head; match approved golden silhouette and original identity lock
immutable.eye_dimensions: exactly two very large turquoise oval eyes; relative width, height, spacing and placement image-bound to approved identity
immutable.eyes: dark pupils, white catchlights, soft lashes, natural depth; turquoise remains stable
immutable.antenna_shape: two thin warm-brown antennae with rounded violet tips
immutable.violet_tips: one rounded violet tip per antenna; stable color and silhouette
immutable.face: wide gentle curved smile, small rounded mouth, thin warm-brown expressive eyebrows, mouth centered low below nose mark
immutable.wing_silhouette: two simple symmetric translucent light-blue teardrop wings with subtle pale veins; one per side behind upper torso; no extra lobes or extra wings
immutable.body: warm luminous yellow; rounded firefly body, short torso, short rounded limbs, stable preschool-readable silhouette
immutable.overalls: light-blue denim-style overalls; two straps, two round yellow buttons, centered front pocket and rolled cuffs; fine denim texture
immutable.shoes: rounded white preschool sneakers with light-blue side and sole accents
immutable.wand: lumi_wand_v1: short violet handle, rounded yellow five-point star tip and warm inner glow; one-handed child-friendly proportions
immutable.wand_trail: small white, yellow and violet particles following star tip; never duplicate the wand or obscure face or educational objects

wand_rules.required: explicitly declare present/visible/held/offscreen in every start and end state; canonical teaching shots retain the approved wand
wand_rules.hands: one continuous plausible grip; no floating, fused hand or swapped hand without a specified natural action
wand_rules.magic: small localized reward only; no object creation, disappearance, count or color change unless explicitly specified and deterministically controlled
wand_rules.educational_pointer: point beside an object, never hide its defining color/geometry or touch through it

measurements.coordinate_system: normalized to verified reference width and height; pose and perspective documented
measurements.rule: Measure from accepted original pixels and record reference SHA/timecode; do not invent numerical dimensions or tolerances. A new 3D model or turnaround requires review.

acceptance: All qualitative locks and image-bound geometry must match; occlusion never justifies inventing hidden anatomy. No scene may reinterpret the model sheet.
